title: The Eve of the Storm
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to step out of the secret chamber, a cold divine sense pierced through the void and stabbed directly into his Mental Sea—it was a message from the Heavenly Eye, containing only a single sentence: Chen Tianming is still alive.

text.content:
In the abyss-like silence, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes.

Deep within his Mental Sea, the fragment of the Tianji Record flickered with a faint glow, as if responding to the turmoil in his heart. Twenty years of waiting, countless midnight dreams and imaginings—all now converged into a single thought: the time has come.

His fingertips gently traced the patterns on the fragment. Those blurry prophetic visions flashed before his eyes. His father's image remained hazy, but the path of fate had become clear.

dialogue.content:
"You have finally made your decision."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly emerged from the fragment, his ethereal face carrying a trace of relief. "Though it came faster than I anticipated. Was it the Tianji Record's revelation, or your own judgment?"

text.content:
A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that grin carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Both. The Tianji Record showed a time window of only seven days, and with the Holy Sect's reaction speed, they can delay at most three more days—the margin left for us is running out."

He rose to his feet, his gaze sweeping across the dense calculation diagrams covering the secret chamber walls. Three months of painstaking effort, every line pointing to the same destination.

dialogue.content:
"Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "What if I told you that from the very beginning, I never intended to follow their script—would you believe me?"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul paused slightly, as if examining this young man. After a moment, he let out a low chuckle: "This old man has waited a long time to hear those words."

text.content:
A strange fluctuation suddenly stirred from deep within the secret chamber.

Chen Ji's eyes turned sharp, yet he made no move. After a moment, a graceful black shadow stepped out from the void. Amid swirling demonic energy, that cold and gorgeous face gradually revealed itself—it was precisely the Demonic Path's Saint, Ye Qing.

"Chen Gongzi," she slightly bowed, her posture elegant yet carrying a hint of scrutiny. "You summoned me late at night—is there something urgent?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's gaze swept across the calculation diagrams covering the secret chamber walls, a flash of astonishment crossing her eyes: "You have... drawn out all of the Holy Sect's arrangements?"

She stepped closer for a better look, and the more she saw, the more alarmed she became: "You even marked the hidden entrances to their protective mountain formation? Chen Ji, how many trump cards are you still hiding?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's questioning made the atmosphere in the secret chamber subtly tense. Facing this Demonic Path Saint's probing, Chen Ji needed to respond—whether to honestly display his strength for trust, or continue hiding to maintain mystery?

choices.text: Honestly reveal everything and conspire together for the grand plan
choices.description: Demonstrate some of the Tianji Record's abilities to Ye Qing, establishing a genuine alliance. This requires taking certain risks, but can make the cooperation closer.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete trust and unlock the "Demonic Mist Resonance" skill
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing betrays, the consequences would be dire
choices.process_label: show Ye Qing the heavenly record

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then raised his hand. The runes on the fragment began to flow, and a blurry image surfaced before both their eyes—a scene Ye Qing had never witnessed, yet made her whole body shudder.

"This is..." Her voice trembled slightly. "This is what the Holy Sect did to me back then. They used me as a vessel and never treated me as a person."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing took a deep breath, her gaze toward Chen Ji completely transformed: "You used the Tianji Record to see my past? This kind of ability..."

She suddenly smiled, that grin carrying a sense of relief: "Chen Ji, I finally understand why you were able to reach where you are today. From this day forward, Ye Qing's life belongs to you."

choices.memory_label: 夜清因天机录见证而彻底归心

choices.description: Only demonstrate part of the layout ability, letting Ye Qing know you are an ally worth cooperating with, but without exposing core secrets. Keep your bargaining chips.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, reduce the risk of betrayal
choices.risk_hint: The depth of cooperation may be limited

text.content:
Chen Ji smiled indifferently: "Ye Qing Shengnv need not be nervous. I simply make a habit of preparing backup plans. Since we intend to make enemies of the Holy Sect, of course I must thoroughly understand their details."

He waved his hand casually, and a Jade Slip flew toward Ye Qing: "This is the internal defense map of the Holy Sect—not complete, but enough for you to understand the general situation."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing received the Jade Slip, her divine sense probing within, and her expression shifted slightly: "You even marked the position of the Holy Sect's Law Enforcement Hall? This is core intelligence..."

She raised her head, her gaze complex: "Chen Ji, I don't know how you managed this, but I'm starting to understand why even the Heavenly Eye must be wary of you."

choices.memory_label: 夜清对陈机的神秘感到敬畏

text.content:
In the secret chamber, the candle flames flickered. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze falling on a yellowed portrait on the wall—the likeness of his mother as he remembered her, the very thing Chen Nian had clutched tightly when she was taken away.

"Ye Qing," he suddenly spoke, his voice low yet carrying an undertone of absolute resolve. "I have one condition."

Ye Qing slightly bowed: "Chen Gongzi, please speak."

dialogue.content:
"Chen Nian—my younger sister—she was taken away by the Holy Sect twelve years ago." Chen Ji turned around, the coldness in his eyes causing even Ye Qing to feel a chill. "I want you to use all the connections of the Demonic Path Holy Sect to give me her exact location within three days."

His tone was calm, but Ye Qing could sense the overwhelming fury suppressed beneath that calmness.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji proposed the request to search for Chen Nian. As the Holy Sect's Saint, Ye Qing needed to weigh the risks and rewards behind this request—should she go all out to deepen the alliance, or hold back to preserve herself?

choices.text: Bounden duty, search with all strength
choices.description: Ye Qing mobilized all her hidden agents within the Holy Sect, even if it meant exposing years of carefully laid plans. This was the most direct response to Chen Ji's sincerity.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Ji's deep trust, unlock 'Heavenly Fate Guidance' clue
choices.risk_hint: Holy Sect may discover the Demonic Path insider

text.content: Ye Qing didn't hesitate for a moment: 'I promise you.' She took out a pitch-black token from her sleeve: 'This is the token of the Holy Sect's hidden guards. With this, I can mobilize all my agents within the Holy Sect. Within three days, there will be news.'

dialogue.content: 'However...' Ye Qing's tone shifted, her expression growing solemn. 'My agent within the Holy Sect sent a strange message. Someone claimed to have seen a woman matching Chen Nian's description deep within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—but that place cannot even be entered easily by the Holy Master.' Her gaze carried a hint of worry: 'Chen Ji, that may be the most dangerous hurdle of your journey.'

choices.memory_label: 夜清为救陈念不惜暴露暗子

choices.description: Ye Qing agrees to help, but will only use外围眼线, not expose core forces. This is protection of her own forces, but may also delay timing.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve hidden agents intact, ensuring future actions
choices.risk_hint: Three days may not yield accurate information

text.content: Ye Qing pondered for a moment: 'I will do my best, but the waters within the Holy Sect run deep. My hidden agents cannot reach the core areas.' She took out a communication jade talisman: 'This is an emergency contact token. Once I have news, I will inform you immediately.'

dialogue.content: 'However...' Ye Qing hesitated, then said, 'I once heard a rumor. The Holy Sect has a Forbidden Grounds specifically for imprisoning those with special constitutions—if your sister truly is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' she is very likely imprisoned there.' She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes carrying a hint of regret: 'I'm sorry, this is all I can do.'

choices.memory_label: 夜清对无法全力帮助感到愧疚

text.content: Just then, a slight fluctuation came from outside the secret chamber. Chen Ji frowned, his divine sense probing, yet sensing nothing. But his intuition had never been wrong—someone was watching from the shadows, and that sensation felt eerily familiar. 'What's wrong?' Ye Qing noticed his unusual state.

dialogue.content: 'Nothing.' Chen Ji withdrew his divine sense, a meaningful smile curling his lips. 'It seems our mysterious friend has appeared again.' Ye Qing was stunned: 'What mysterious friend?' Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply took out a jade slip from his chest, placing it gently on the table. The jade slip's surface bore an unusual rune—their secret signal.

text.content: A moment later, the jade slip suddenly glowed with faint light. Words gradually appeared: 'The Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, Heavenly Fate Altar. She is still alive, but the person guarding her is more dangerous than you can imagine. Remember—trust no one, not even your own eyes.' At the signature was only one symbol: an eye with a line through it.

choice.prompt: The mysterious helper's information appeared again, with an especially stern warning—'Trust no one, including your own eyes.' What truth lies behind these words? Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this mysterious hint.

choices.description: This warning is too bizarre. One must clarify the other party's origins and purpose. Chen Ji decided to investigate the clues, even if it meant risking exposure.
choices.visible_reward: Uncover a corner of the mysterious person's identity
choices.risk_hint: The other party has hidden for so long, they must not be easily dealt with

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the crossed-out eye symbol, suddenly recalling something: 'This symbol... I have seen it in a fragmentary text of the Tianji Record.' He closed his eyes, his Mental Sea rapidly searching. Finally, a vague passage emerged—a record about the 'Abandoned Child of Heavenly Dao.'

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly trembled: "This symbol... impossible, that is the mark of the 'Heaven-Defying One!'"

His voice carried a rare shock: "Chen Ji, you must be careful. Those who can use this symbol are either pawns abandoned by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, or existences who chose to betray it willingly—either way, it means a massive variable."

choices.memory_label: 发现神秘人与「逆天者」有关

choices.text: Set aside for now, focus on the main storyline.
choices.description: Regardless of who the other party is, the most important thing now is to save Chen Nian. Chen Ji decided not to investigate this lead further for the time being, focusing his energy on the action three days later.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the rhythm of action, do not be disturbed.
choices.risk_hint: Since the other party issued a warning, there must be deep meaning.

text.content:
Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, his expression calm: "Whoever the other party is, their purpose temporarily aligns with ours. Since that's the case, there's no need to create complications at this moment."

He turned to Ye Qing: "Three days' time, each of us prepares. Remember, once the action begins, there's no turning back."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing nodded, a flash of determination flickering in her eyes: "I understand. In three days, at the Holy Sect."

With that, her figure merged into the Void once more, disappearing into the secret chamber. Before leaving, she glanced back at Chen Ji, her gaze carrying a complex mix of emotions.

text.content:
After Ye Qing left, the secret chamber returned to silence.

Chen Ji stood in place, his gaze falling on the mysterious Jade Slip. "Do not trust anyone, including your own eyes"—these words were like a thorn, embedded in his heart.

He closed his eyes, and the fragments of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded in his Mental Sea. The scenes of three days later began to blur... no, not blurring, but being obscured by something.

dialogue.content:
"It's Chen Nian." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke solemnly, "Her existence is interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight—this is precisely one of the characteristics of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key.' The closer you get to her, the more your foresight fails."

He paused, his voice growing grave: "But this is also a double-edged sword. The reason the Holy Sect kept her alive is precisely because of this ability—it can shield the Holy Sect from the Tianji Record's窥探."

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes.

He suddenly understood something—why the mysterious person warned him "not to trust his own eyes." If the Tianji Record's foresight could fail due to Chen Nian's presence, then the scenes he saw at critical moments might be precisely wrong.

"The Holy Sect... what deep scheming." he murmured, yet there was no fear in his eyes, only a sharp gleam flickering within.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of mockery: "They think they can seal my eyes with Chen Nian? How naive."

He took out an ancient jade bottle from his chest—the item Mo Xiansheng had given him during the previous unsealing, said to be able to temporarily break through the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key's' interference at a crucial moment.

"Since you want to play, I'll play along with you."

text.content:
The candle flame in the corner of the secret chamber suddenly flickered violently.

Chen Ji's brow furrowed, and he turned to look. There was nothing there, but that sensation of being watched grew stronger—not from Ye Qing, nor from the mysterious person, but from something far more ancient and terrifying.

The next instant, a cold divine consciousness pierced through the Void, like a blade stabbing directly into his Mental Sea.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji."

That voice had no emotion, no temperature, like Heavenly Dao itself speaking. Each word carried a suffocating pressure.

"Your chess game has been played well. But do you think, truly, someone is helping you in the shadows?"

That voice let out a cold snort that sounded neither like laughter nor contempt: "The Holy Sect trip in three days—I will show you that all your schemes are under my observation."

text.content:
The divine consciousness pressure came quickly, and left quickly as well.

Chen Ji stood in place, his face slightly pale, yet he didn't retreat a single step. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently beside him, as if struck by extreme shock.

"That was..." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a thread of fear, "the main consciousness of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. It actually contacted you directly?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not answer Mo Xiansheng's question. He slowly raised his hand, looking at the residual divine consciousness ripples in his palm, when his lips suddenly curved into a smile.

That smile was cold and dangerous, like the tranquility before a storm.

"The more it acts like this, the closer I am to its bottom line." Chen Ji said quietly, "Three days later... fine, let's see whose chess game is more sophisticated."

A gleam flickered in his eyes—that was long-missing battle intent—no, not battle intent, but the excitement of a hunter locking onto prey.

text.content:
However, just as Chen Ji was about to step out of the secret chamber—

His footsteps abruptly stopped.

The Tianji Record fragments suddenly vibrated violently, and a blurry scene forcefully flooded into his Mental Sea. In that scene, a person he never expected to see again was standing amidst chaotic light.

That person turned around, revealing an aged yet still resolute face—it was Chen Ji's father, Chen Tianming.

And his lips slightly parted, silently uttering four words:

"I am... still alive."

In the secret chamber, the candle flame suddenly extinguished, then flared back to life.

Chen Ji stood in place, utterly motionless.

His face showed no expression, but the hand gripping the fragment trembled slightly—not from fear, but because an emotion suppressed for twenty years was churning violently in his chest.

He was still alive.

Father... was still alive.

At this moment, Chen Ji suddenly felt that all schemes and all calculations no longer mattered. Twenty years of waiting, countless midnight dreams and fantasies, now all converged into one thought—

Whatever lies ahead, he would bring his father back.
